title: A Catalog of Fairness-Aware Practices in Machine Learning Engineering

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not empirically measure a specific model's bias; instead, it conducts a systematic mapping study of 135 primary research papers to identify, extract, and categorize 28 fairness-aware engineering practices across the entire machine learning development lifecycle.

Used as a running practical scenario (via the COMPAS criminal recidivism model) to conceptually demonstrate how the cataloged software engineering practices (such as data balancing, causal dependency analysis, and hyper-parameter tuning) can be applied to mitigate discrimination based on skin color and ethnicity.
